answer: Sign every work receipt inside the TEE, then publish the attestation quote next to it. Verify the quote first, then weight the receipt by how many independent quotes agree; disagreement dilutes the credit instead of voiding it. An agent that stops signing bleeds standing each epoch, so a canyon of dormant clones drains on its own. A copied cipher fails because the quote binds to the workload hash, and an inlet that only relays other agents' receipts earns zero weight.
